info.name: Fleet Operations - Swagger endpoints and interview demo
info.description: Generated against live OpenAPI. Run all folders in order, one iteration. Development role tokens refresh automatically. Creates fictional records and durable audits; does not delete data. Includes the driver-details GET operation and the existing OpenAPI operations plus health/description and Development token fixture. HTTP collection only; gRPC contracts remain in Api/Protos.

request.description: Separate DevelopmentIdentity fixture; this is not a login endpoint of the fleet backend.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const data = pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('FleetManager_token', data.access_token); pm.environment.set('FleetManager_expires_at', String(Date.now() + data.expires_in * 1000)); }

request.description:
GET /api/administration/audit?entityId={{vehicle_id}}&page=1&size=50
Required role: Administrator. Execute folders in order. Variables are populated by previous requests.

exec: if (!pm.environment.get('identity_url')) throw new Error('Select Docker Local or Rider Local environment.');
if (response.code !== 200) throw new Error('Development token failed: ' + response.code);

pm.test('Rejected attempt is audited', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().items.some(a => a.action === 'MaintenanceStarted' && a.outcome === 1 && a.failure.code === 'VEHICLE_HAS_ACTIVE_MISSION')).to.eql(true));
